documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Discussion And Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended Sep 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported a strong start to FY27 with 27% year-on-year revenue growth, 55% EBITDA growth, and 64% PAT growth in Q1. Management noted that construction equipment demand remains healthy, while large agricultural equipment is experiencing a cyclical bottom in calendar year 2026 with recovery anticipated in 2027. The company's balance sheet remains robust with a net cash position of approximately INR190 crores, supporting ongoing evaluations of inorganic acquisition opportunities. Uniparts India reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, noting a revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55%, and PAT growth of 64%. Management highlighted that the restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well with uninterrupted customer supply, while Mexico warehouse operations remain on track for first customer deliveries in Q3.

guidance.claim: The company expects full fiscal growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than FY26 on a year-on-year basis.
guidance.quote: our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: The company expects overall growth in FY27 to be in line with what was achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: The small agriculture segment in North America is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs indicate that calendar year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom for large agricultural equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: India's small agricultural equipment segment is supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket revenue represented approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural equipment industry is expected to face mid-teens decline in 2026.
demand_outlook.quote: We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending under technology investments in the US and government-led spending in Europe are sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: India continues to perform well in the small agriculture segment, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across mid-to-higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: In Western markets, small agriculture growth remains more measured with consumer appetite tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility.
demand_outlook.quote: In Western markets, small ag growth remains more measured.

demand_outlook.claim: Conditions remain subdued in large agriculture, with leading OEMs indicating that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom.
demand_outlook.quote: Conditions remain subdued, as has been widely acknowledged across the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket revenues were flat year-on-year in absolute terms and represented approximately 12% of revenues in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Aftermarket represents approximately 12% of revenues in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment in North America.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: In Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs affirmed that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough for large agricultural machinery.
demand_outlook.quote: Let me talk about the large agricultural machinery, continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.

demand_outlook.claim: Sequentially, management expects Q1 to be in line with Q4 and the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4. And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores for capacity enhancement and productivity improvement.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3 of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of materials for the quarter is about 33.3% due to product mix change.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: The small inventory gain seen on the face of financials is roughly about INR1 crore.
margins_costs.quote: There has been a small inventory gain that you will see on the face of the financials, and that's roughly about INR1 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Cycle EBITDA margins over peak to trough are about 20%.
margins_costs.quote: So Mr. Jain, when we talk about 20% margins, we are talking about 20% margins over a cycle which is peak to trough.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin as a percentage of revenue from operations was 66.6% in Q1 FY27 compared to 65.6% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (As % of Revenue from Ops) 66.6% 64.7% 65.6%

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 25.3% compared to 20.7% in Q1 FY26.
Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% in quarter 4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: The company has stated consistently that a 20% EBITDA margin is sustainable over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability performance accounts for a INR3.4 crores impact due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: On a trailing twelve-month basis, the new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at approximately INR190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of June 30.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate its strategic agenda.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, which included a special dividend of INR101 crores declared in Q3 of FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility led to demand skewing in the aftermarket segment as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Towards the end of quarter 3, one of the facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident in the finishing shop.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fresh escalation in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

risks_headwinds.claim: The evolving geopolitical situation has resulted in increasing input prices, some of which is being mitigated by favorable exchange rates.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the evolving geopolitical situation has resulted in increasing input prices, some of this inflation is being mitigated by favourable exchange rates.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the warehouse in Mexico are expected in Q3 of this year.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: The fabrication vertical will become a meaningful vertical in the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that efforts are underway to rebuild the fire-damaged facility and be online by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Right. So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.
